recalls_by_vehicle.description: Safety recall campaigns for one make + model + model year (all three required).

make.desc: make, case-insensitive: honda, toyota, ford, tesla

model.desc: model as NHTSA spells it: civic, camry, f-150, model 3 (see products_models)

variants.desc: pack option, not sent (default false): true also fetches the names products_models lists as this model plus only powertrain/body/cab/drive words (HYBRID, PHEV, EV, SEDAN, (CREW CAB), AWD), one campaign once; other names starting with the model are listed in a note, never merged

recall_campaign.description: One recall campaign by NHTSA campaign number (one row per make/model/year covered).

complaints_by_vehicle.description: Consumer complaints (ODI) for one make + model + model year, all on one page.

variants.desc: pack option, not sent (default false): true also fetches the names products_models lists as this model plus only powertrain/body/cab/drive words (complaints use those exact names), one complaint once; other names are listed in a note, never merged

products_model_years.description: Model years that have recalls (issueType r) or complaints (c).

products_makes.description: Makes for a model year that have recalls (r) or complaints (c).

products_models.description: Models of a make and year that have recalls (r) or complaints (c): the exact names to use (the full list: the pack sends a large max).

ratings_model_years.description: Model years with NCAP 5-Star Safety Ratings.

ratings_makes.description: Makes with NCAP ratings for a model year.

ratings_models.description: Models with NCAP ratings for a make and model year.

ratings_vehicles.description: Rated variants (VehicleId, description: body style, drive) of a make + model + year.

ratings_detail.description: NCAP star ratings (overall, frontal, side, rollover), rollover probability, ADAS fitment, and complaint/recall/investigation counts for one VehicleId.

vin_decode.description: vPIC: decode a VIN (17 characters; partial VINs with * allowed) into about 150 flat fields.

modelyear.desc: optional model year, helps pre-1980 and partial VINs

vpic_models_for_make_year.description: vPIC: every model a make produced for a model year (Make_ID, Model_ID, Model_Name).

vpic_models_for_make.description: vPIC: every model of a make, all years.

vpic_all_makes.description: vPIC: every make registered with NHTSA (about 12,000 rows, includes trailers and motorcycles).

car_seat_stations_state.description: Child car seat inspection stations in a state (two-letter code); 100 a page, paged with offset.

state.desc: two-letter state code, upper case: CA

car_seat_stations_zip.description: Child car seat inspection stations for a ZIP code.
